latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of OpenClaw Search: a unified API for intelligent, multi-source retrieval (web, academic, Tavily).
- Provides confidence-scored answers through meta-analysis of retrieved results.
- Supports parallel search via web, academic, smart, and Tavily streams.
- Includes Python and curl client examples for all major features and endpoints.
- Features confidence scoring engine with transparency on source quality, recency, and consensus.
- Full API reference with endpoints and required parameters included.
